exposure: reasons for hysterectomies (uterine atony, uterine rupture, placenta previa, retained placenta, placenta percreta)
cohort: The study included 36 patients who underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy at a civil hospital in Ahmedabad, selected from 15,682 total deliveries.
finding: The incidence of obstetric hysterectomy was 0.22 per 1,000 deliveries, with uterine atony being the leading cause (36%), and 5 maternal deaths were reported.
mod_finding: Twenty-seven hysterectomies followed caesarean deliveries, while nine followed vaginal deliveries, and Caesarean delivery was identified as a risk factor.
